hero.title: Make your next
hero.subtitle: The human heart beats three billion times in a lifetime. Three Billion Heartbeats exists so the ones you have left carry real direction. No theory. No perfection. Concrete action, heartbeat by heartbeat.
hero.langNote: AI mentoring in English. Every heartbeat, a real choice.

features.title: Every heartbeat, a step forward
features.subtitle: A mentorship that understands where you are and walks with you toward action, heartbeat by heartbeat.

noJudgment.title: No judgment
noJudgment.description: Only questions that move you forward. No unsolicited advice, no evaluations, no pressure.

realState.title: Real state
realState.description: Detects if you're blocked, anxious, or clear and adapts the conversation to where you really are.

concreteAction.title: Concrete action
concreteAction.description: Every conversation ends with a real next step you can execute today in under 10 minutes.

step1.title: Describe how you feel
step1.description: No filters, no judgment. Tell Three Billion Heartbeats what's happening, what you're avoiding, what's holding you back.

step2.title: Get clarity
step2.description: Blocked, anxious, doubtful, or clear — the conversation adapts to where you are.

step3.title: Act in under 5 min
step3.description: A concrete, actionable next step that generates real momentum starting today.

finalCta.title2: The ones ahead are still yours.
finalCta.subtitle: Three billion heartbeats in a lifetime. How many passed without you feeling them?
finalCta.disclaimer: Does not replace therapy or professional psychological intervention.

chatMockup.msg1User: I've been stuck on my project for weeks
chatMockup.msg2Ai: What's the smallest thing you could do in the next 10 minutes?
chatMockup.msg3User: I guess open the file and write a paragraph
chatMockup.msg4Ai: That's exactly what you need. Do it now. Then tell me about it.
